A '''duel''' took place around [[533 BBY]]<ref name="Note" /> in a [[Darth Gravid's bastion|bastion]] on [[Jaguada/Legends|Jaguada]] between [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Dark Lord of the Sith]] [[Darth Gravid]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Darth Gean]]. Gean successfully killed Gravid because the former attempted to destroy the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] teachings, however she was severely injured in the duel and was forced to wear [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetics]].<ref name="DP" />
